title: When Does Discrete Ricci Curvature Help? An Edge-Level Analysis of Curvature-Enhanced GCNs for PPI Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.21849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. But does CGCN's improvement actually come from mitigating over-squashing? We investigate this on four real-world protein-protein interaction (PPI) datasets, comparing CGCN against a standard GCN at the level of individual edges rather than aggregate metrics alone. While CGCN improves aggregate AUC, AUPR, and F1 across all four datasets, this gain is concentrated almost entirely on low-degree edges, while performance on low-curvature (bottleneck) edges systematically degrades in three of four datasets, the opposite of what the over-squashing motivation predicts. translated_title: 离散里奇曲率何时有效？面向蛋白质相互作用预测的曲率增强图卷积网络的边级分析
translated_abstract: 曲率增强图卷积网络（CGCN）将基于最优传输理论的Ollivier-Ricci曲率（ORC）融入消息传递机制，其动机源于这样的主张：曲率加权的边能够缓解结构瓶颈处的“过度挤压”问题。但CGCN的改进实际上是否来自缓解过度挤压？我们在四个真实的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）数据集上研究这一问题，在单个边的层面上而非仅通过聚合指标来比较CGCN与标准GCN。虽然CGCN在所有四个数据集上都提升了聚合的AUC、AUPR和F1指标，但这种提升几乎完全集中在低度数边上；而在四个数据集中的三个里，低曲率（瓶颈）边的性能反而出现系统性下降，这与过度挤压动机所预测的恰恰相反。通过直接考察学习到的边权重函数，并结合聚类有效性指标和边距离比率……
tldr: 本文通过边级分析揭示，曲率增强GCN在PPI预测中的性能提升主要来自低度数边，而低曲率瓶颈边的性能反而系统性下降，从而挑战了“曲率加权通过缓解过度挤压带来改进”这一传统解释。
en_tdlr: An edge-level analysis shows that curvature-enhanced GCNs' gains in PPI prediction come almost entirely from low-degree edges while low-curvature bottleneck edges systematically degrade, challenging the claim that curvature weighting helps by mitigating over-squashing.
